Network Security

सुरक्षित पैकेट अग्रेषण

The practice of transmitting data packets across networks in a manner that maintains confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity as defined by NIST SP 800-53 and IETF RFC 4301.

Definition

The practice of transmitting data packets across networks in a manner that maintains confidentiality, integrity, and authenticity as defined by NIST SP 800-53 and IETF RFC 4301.

Operational example

Ensure secure packet forwarding by enforcing IPsec tunnels between all branch offices and the data center gateways.
